# Dewey Dunnington

> > Personal website of Dewey Dunnington, Software Engineer & Geoscientist specializing in geospatial data processing with Apache Arrow, SedonaDB, and modern spatial analytics tools.

This site features technical articles and tutorials on geospatial data engineering, focusing on GeoParquet, Apache Sedona, DuckDB, and Arrow-native workflows. Dewey works at Wherobots and contributes to open-source geospatial and data interoperability projects.

## Key Topics

- SedonaDB
- Apache Sedona
- GeoParquet
- DuckDB
- Apache Arrow
- GeoArrow
- nanoarrow
- GeoPandas
- Arrow Database Connectivity (ADBC)
- Wherobots
- Spatial SQL
- Geodata cleaning
- Geospatial data processing
- R and Python development
- Lake geochemistry

## About

- [Dewey Dunnington](https://dewey.dunnington.ca): Homepage for Dewey Dunnington: Software Engineer & Geoscientist at Wherobots

## Geospatial Data Engineering

- [(Geo)Data cleaning with Arrow and SedonaDB](https://dewey.dunnington.ca/post/2025/geodata-cleaning-with-arrow-and-sedonadb): Tutorial on geodata cleaning using SedonaDB, DuckDB, and PostGIS workflows
- [Lazy GeoParquet reading in SedonaDB, DuckDB, GeoPandas, and GDAL](https://dewey.dunnington.ca/post/2025/lazy-geoparquet-reading-in-sedonadb-duckdb-geopandas-and-gdal): Comparison of lazy GeoParquet reading across SedonaDB, DuckDB, GeoPandas, GDAL
- [Stream network traversal with SedonaDB](https://dewey.dunnington.ca/post/2025/stream-network-traversal-with-sedonadb): Geospatial analysis tutorial for stream network traversal using SedonaDB
